decision: Set the active planning scope to the Doctor feature and onboarding flow rework for newbie vibecoders, with this turn limited to plan review and ledger-only synthesis rather than canonical Plans edits.
rationale: Jared explicitly named the feature, audience, and simplicity constraint, and asked to first review what current Plans already contain before designing the rework.

decision: Treat `Concepts/PMConcept.html` as non-final GUI concept/reference evidence for the Doctor/onboarding redesign, not as final GUI canon or an implementation target.
rationale: Jared corrected the source set by saying to look at `pmconcept.html` because it is the concept for GUI, explicitly `not final`.

decision: First-run onboarding will be a separate modal/wizard before the user enters the full shell, and it will be skippable guided setup.
rationale: Jared answered both first-run entry and onboarding posture directly: `separate modal/wizard before the user enters the full shell` and `Skippable guided setup.`

decision: Provider setup onboarding will tell users to set up paid providers first, and Fee/Free Models appear afterward.
rationale: Jared answered the provider sequencing question directly with `Fee models appear after telling the user to setup paid providers.`

decision: Doctor remains a Health summary in this redesign, not a new generic Doctor registry/result aggregator.
rationale: Jared answered the Doctor scope question directly with `Doctor remains as a health summary.`

decision: The onboarding wizard is scoped to provider setup and should tell users they can use Assistant Chat to access Teacher for anything they need to know.
rationale: Jared narrowed onboarding: `Just setup providers and tell the user that they can use the assistant chat to access teacher who can tell them anything they need to know.`

decision: After setup completes, the user is routed into the Planning Wizard page.
rationale: Jared answered the post-setup destination directly: `After the setup, it dumps the user into the planning Wizard page.`

decision: Accept the four-screen provider setup wizard proposal as the detailed onboarding flow: Connect Puppet Master to an AI provider, Set up a paid provider, Optional: Free Models, and You are ready to plan; keep Skip for now routing to Planning Wizard in limited setup state; keep Fee/Free Models after the paid-provider prompt; keep Assistant Chat/Teacher handoff copy; and keep Doctor as compact Health summary.
rationale: Jared reviewed the proposed wizard packet and answered `That all looks good.`
